Maya Chen: Quick idea — run a 3-week launch for the community refapp: week1 tutorial, week2 benchmark + blog, week3 webinar + office hours
Alex Rivera: :thumbsup: love it. Timeline?
Maya Chen: Week of Apr 28 start. Draft schedule: Mon tutorial blog + repo, Wed benchmark post + notebook, Fri live demo/webinar + signup
Priya Nair: We need messaging templates for each asset. I can draft 3 CTAs: 'Get started', 'See benchmark', 'Join demo'.
Tom Baker: For inbound routing — form -> HubSpot form -> auto-tag 'dev-refapp' -> Slack alert to #sales-dev
Alex Rivera: Routing note: make sure we set lead score + UTM rules; I can add webhook to Segment.
Maya Chen: Benchmark narrative: focus on latency/cost vs vanilla serving + sample prompts. Include a 'how we measured' appendix
Priya Nair: Can we get an example script for the benchmark in the repo? e.g.
Tom Baker: ```bash
python benchmarks/run.py --model redwood-llm-small --concurrency 4 --seq 512
```
Alex Rivera: Webinar format: 20m demo, 20m benchmark walk-through, 20m Q&A. Invite committer engineers to co-host
Maya Chen: Need landing page copy + registration form. @Priya can you own copy? @Tom own routing+tech
Priya Nair: I got copy. Will post draft by Tue.
Tom Baker: I'll set up HubSpot form + Segment tags today. Will test with curl.
Tom Baker: ```bash
curl -X POST https://hubspot.test/forms -d '{"email":"test@example.com","utm_source":"newsletter"}'
```
Alex Rivera: Also promo plan: community Slack post, tweet thread, short demo video clip. Keep messaging dev-focused: 'ship LLM features faster'
Maya Chen: Good. Let's lock hero image and benchmark graph by Wed. @Eden where are we on graph?
Eden Park: Draft graph ready, will iterate on colors and annotations today.
Priya Nair: I'll ping design now.
Marketing Bot: Reminder — weekly marketing sync tomorrow 10am. Add this to agenda.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. I'll create GH project and assign tasks.
